retirementAuthority: The user explicitly requested removal of custom Before/After, selective comparison controls, technical/history/not-applied panels, and use of the editor native Mostrar alterações control.
retainedCoverage: All historical source article inputs and independently written expected endpoints, with exactly one reviewed static Aeroclubes spacing extension recorded separately.
Apply and exact Undo through real browser Workers, modular and complete distributions.
Positive and negative biography, marriage, reference, table, images, copied syntax, citation metadata and category proofs.
Saved-revision minor-edit ownership, applied occurrence totals, exact UTF-8 metrics, idempotence, checked-state freshness, failures and cancellation.
Large complex articles, numeric table rows, scientific identifiers/formulas, complete source hashes and protected contexts.
Stable installation chains, lazy reading-page behavior and preserved native edit links.
retiredCoverage: Custom Before/After rendering and occurrence-ledger DOM.
Custom per-hunk rejection/reacceptance and selection-driven partial endpoints.
newCoverage: Confirmed native wpDiff submit controls, direct input/button and widget input/button.
Missing, wrong-name, non-submit, outside-form and mismatched-form controls keep the shortcut hidden. Confirmed disabled native controls keep it hidden or disabled.
Native shortcut click stub leaves exact source/count/summary/Undo intact, no remote diff renderer or form submission is claimed.
actualFlowCounts: Recorded from the final browser execution; no historical passing count is relabeled.
